text: Puka Nacua (knee, turf toe) is headed to IR. The Rams hope to have him back around Week 14 or 15.
Malik Willis (groin) is on IR. Rookie Kyle McCord makes his first start Sunday against the Colts.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza is the Raiders' new starting quarterback. A small step down for Brock Bowers.
Kirk Cousins is back in Minnesota, traded from the Raiders. He's expected to start, a boost for Justin Jefferson.
Josh Downs was traded from the Colts to the Chiefs.
Keenan Allen was traded from the Colts to the 49ers.
Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is uncertain for Week 10. The Patriots had no update after his MRIs.
Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is out for the season.
Terry McLaurin (knee) is out for the season.
Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is out for Week 10.
The Eagles traded DT Jordan Davis to the Jaguars for a 2027 first-round pick (No. 24 in our draft order) and a 2029 second.
The Falcons traded S Jessie Bates III to the Jaguars for a 2027 second-round pick (No. 55 in our draft order) and a 2028 fifth.
Patrick Mahomes' elbow MRI showed no major injury. He's expected to play Sunday at Atlanta.
Jacoby Brissett traded to the Ravens. He's starting while Lamar Jackson is on IR.
The Saints claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers from the Browns.
Davante Adams is ahead of schedule after hamstring surgery. Sean McVay expects him back on the short end of 6-10 weeks, possibly Week 12 or 13.
